properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: MD5 ships in the build only through the solc toolchain dependency (content-hash of compiler artifacts, non-security purpose); no first-party MD5 call site exists in src/, tests/, examples/ or benches/. Changeable here only by dropping the ethers-solc feature or patching the transitive tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-1 in this build comes from sha1@0.10.6 (Cargo.lock:5363), consumed by tungstenite 0.20.1 (dep edge L6118) for the RFC 6455 WebSocket handshake — Sec-WebSocket-Accept is SHA-1 by protocol mandate, pulled by ethers' ws provider feature — and by zip 0.6.6 (L6688, via ethers-solc) for legacy archive checksums. No call site in this repo's own sources; purpose is handshake integrity, not collision resistance.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 ECDSA is the Ethereum transaction signature scheme, fixed by the chain's consensus rules — observable here, replaceable only by an Ethereum protocol change, not unilaterally by this repo. The use is test-only (signs a raw legacy tx to exercise trace_raw_transaction). Classical signature, so it is a deadline risk (Shor), not a harvest-now-decrypt-later one.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The dependency backing every ethers signing wallet in this repo (tests/test_middleware.rs:476, examples/generate_testdata.rs via LocalWallet). Quantum-unsafe signature primitive; migration for Ethereum transaction signing is protocol-gated, ML-DSA-65 for non-protocol uses.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 is the ENR (Ethereum Node Record) identity-key signature scheme: enr@0.9.1 depends on ed25519-dalek (Cargo.lock:1569), and enr is the record format of discv5 0.3.1 (L1401), reth's devp2p discovery — shipped because this crate embeds the full reth network stack (see src/lib.rs RethApi wiring). Deadline risk class (signature forgery under Shor), not harvest-now. No application call site in this repo's own code; the algorithm is fixed by the discv5/ENR spec — changeable only upstream in the

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: One asset: the k256 secp256k1 ECDSA signing chain in the test file (import at :16, wallet from hardcoded key at :476-477, sign_transaction_sync at :492). Ethereum-protocol curve; test-only use.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: curve25519-dalek provides the X25519/Ed25519 group arithmetic. Its only consumer edge in this lockfile is ed25519-dalek@2.0.0 (L1486) → enr (node records) → discv5 discovery. The X25519 key-agreement capability ships in the binary; the session-handshake call sites live inside the pinned git dependency, not in this repo's code. Retroactive risk class if exercised for discovery session key agreement — harvest-now-decrypt-later applies to recorded devp2p discovery traffic.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: No first-party call site; ships in the build through ethers-signers' keystore support. HMAC-SHA256 is quantum-safe in practice (Grover only halves key strength, 128-bit remains ample).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keystore-format KDF (PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256, 262144 iterations per Web3 secret storage spec). Separately, BIP39 mnemonic-to-seed uses PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 with 2048 iterations — that path IS exercised at examples/generate_testdata.rs:39-42 (MnemonicBuilder, hardcoded 12-word mnemonic); 2048 iterations there is the BIP39 standard applied to a 128-bit-entropy mnemonic, not password stretching. No first-party keystore-file call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 (sha2@0.10.8, Cargo.lock:5374) is the workhorse digest: coins-bip32/coins-bip39 HD wallet derivation (L913/929), eth-keystore keystore KDF+MAC (L1660), k256 ECDSA message hashing (L2986), bs58 base58check (L703), reth-ecies RLPx MAC (L4302), backend for hkdf/scrypt/pbkdf2, and the EVM SHA-256 precompile (revm-precompile edge L4855). Quantum-safe under Grover. Sibling digest crates in the same lockfile that the dep_scan dictionary has no object for, recorded here so the gap is visible: ke

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt is the memory-hard KDF option of Ethereum keystore files (Web3 secret storage, default N=262144). Quantum-safe in practice (Grover only). Capability ships via the dependency tree; not invoked by first-party code in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HS256 secret is a pre-shared key with the node (Ethereum engine-API spec: random hex >=32 chars). No first-party JWT call site in this repo; the capability ships via both ethers-providers and reth-rpc. Symmetric MAC — quantum impact limited to Grover, not Shor.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: TLS 1.3 is the right version; the exposure is its classical key share — provider RPC traffic is retroactively decryptable by a future quantum attacker (harvest now, decrypt later). Fix is a version/provider upgrade: rustls 0.23.20+ with aws-lc-rs enables X25519MLKEM768 hybrid. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt is the memory-hard KDF for Ethereum V3 keystores: eth-keystore 0.5.0 (pulled by the ethers signer stack) depends on it (Cargo.lock:1657) to derive keystore encryption keys from passphrases; its internals are pbkdf2-hmac-sha2 with salsa20 as the mixing core (L5156). No keystore call site in this repo's own code — presence in the shipped build is the inventory fact. Same algorithm as ALG-c1f8b585 (scrypt).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: MD5 ships via ethers-solc 2.0.10 (dep edge Cargo.lock:1979), used there for solc-artifact checksums — a non-security integrity purpose, not collision resistance of authenticated data. Collision-broken hash available in the shipped binary; no application call site in this repo. Same algorithm as ALG-70109388 (MD5).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: k256 0.13.1 is the secp256k1 ECDSA library the build ships (via ethers-core); algorithm identity, quantum-unsafety and use sites are carried on the linked ECDSA-secp256k1 object.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ring 0.16.20 is the legacy ring line (upstream moved to aws-lc-rs); it contains no post-quantum algorithms. This is the layer a rustls upgrade swaps out. Shipped via the dependency tree, not called directly by first-party code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: aes-gcm@0.9.4 is discv5's encrypted discovery-packet AEAD (dep edge Cargo.lock:1397). Same crate and purpose as ALG-f61ec50f, which carries the full context.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ed25519-dalek is the ENR identity-key implementation consumed by enr@0.9.1 (Cargo.lock:1569) for discv5 discovery node records. Same crate and purpose as ALG-683d5cd2, which carries the full context.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: jsonwebtoken 8.3.0 ships via ethers-providers and reth-rpc; default HS256 via ring. Algorithm identity, consumers and quantum posture are carried on the linked JWT-signing object.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The sha1 crate is consumed by tungstenite 0.20.1 for the WebSocket handshake (Cargo.lock:6118) and by zip 0.6.6 for legacy archive checksums (L6688). Same crate and purpose as ALG-725ecd3e, which carries the full context.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HMAC-SHA256 is the MAC/KDF backbone of the wallet and network stacks: eth-keystore keystore MAC (Cargo.lock:1654), coins-bip32/coins-bip39 key derivation (L910/925), hkdf 0.12.3 for discv5 session keys (L2422), reth-ecies RLPx header MAC (L4295), zip legacy encryption (L6687). Quantum-safe MAC. Same algorithm as ALG-0db1f0bc (HMAC).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pbkdf2 0.11.0 ships via eth-keystore (Web3 secret-storage KDF, 262144 iterations) — capability present, no first-party call site. The live mnemonic-derivation site (BIP39, 2048 iterations) is reported as a separate finding at examples/generate_testdata.rs.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-2 family is quantum-safe in practice (Grover halves preimage strength; 128-bit remains ample). No first-party direct call site; ships via the dependency tree. Ethereum's native hash is keccak-256 (separate crates: keccak, tiny-keccak, sha3), not SHA-2.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: curve25519-dalek is the X25519/Ed25519 group arithmetic backing ed25519-dalek@2.0.0 (Cargo.lock:1486) for ENR node records in discv5 discovery. Same crate and purpose as ALG-82f1eeb2, which carries the full context.
